description_en: Calls the Feedback operation to like or dislike a response in a conversation
description_zh: 调用Feedback接口进行问答点赞、点踩
name: Feedback

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the chatbot
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID, which identifies a visitor's session and maintains context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to pass this field when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId in the response of the Chat operation. For subsequent conversation turns of the same visitor, pass the current SessionId when calling the Chat operation so that the chatbot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId
parameters.help_zh:
会话ID，⽤于标识⼀个访问者 的会话和保持上下⽂信息。对
于⼀个新的访问者，⾸次调⽤ Chat接⼝时⽆需传递此字段， 机器⼈会开启⼀个会话，并在 Chat接⼝的响应中返回该会话 的SessionId。对于该访问者的 后续轮次的会话，调⽤Chat接
⼝时传递当前会话的 SessionId，机器⼈即可基于 SessionId继续该轮次会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the response message in the conversation
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en:
The feedback type. Valid values:

good: like
bad: dislike
parameters.name: feedback

parameters.help_en: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

Feedback.description_en:
The feedback type. Valid values:

good: like
bad: dislike

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the conversation message

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

false: The operation failed.
true: The operation was successful
